tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_project_milestones
tools.description: Returns all scheduled milestones and their dates for a given MCPHawk Inc project. This tool delivers a detailed timeline of milestones for a project, including: - Milestone names (e.g., Sprint-1, Sprint-2, QA Release, Production Release) - Corresponding milestone dates - Planned Cumulative Burn in USD for different project milestones - Actual Burn based on MCPHawk Inc employee billing - Cumulative Actual Burn rate basedon Actual Burn rate values (This is important to understand the financials of the project) This tool is helpful for project managers, scrum masters, and stakeholders to track progress, important delivery dates and understand if project is running within budget or not and understnad financial health of the project. **Input:** - `project_name` (str): The project whose milestones are requested. **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `project_name` (str): The name of the project - `milestones` (list): A list of dictionaries, each with: - `actual_burn` (float): Actual burn recorded for this milestone period - `cumulative_actual_burn` (float): Cumulative total of actual burn up to this milestone If no milestones are found, returns a message indicating absence of data. **Example Response:** { "project_name": "Grow Efficient Synergies", "milestones": [ { "milestone": "Sprint-1", "milestone_date": "2025-02-25", "planned_cumulative_burn": 113160.0, "actual_burn": 106528.85, "cumulative_actual_burn": 106529.0 }, { "milestone": "Sprint-2", "milestone_date": "2025-03-11", "planned_cumulative_burn": 226321.0, "actual_burn": 111444.79, "cumulative_actual_burn": 217974.0 }, { "milestone": "UAT Release", "milestone_date": "2025-05-20", "planned_cumulative_burn": 905283.52, "actual_burn": 107937.74, "cumulative_actual_burn": 881532.64 }, { "milestone": "Production Release", "milestone_date": "2025-05-27", "planned_cumulative_burn": 1018443.96, "actual_burn": 107682.72, "cumulative_actual_burn": 989215.36 } ] }

tools.name: Statistical_Analysis_MCP_correlation_test
tools.description: Accepts two variables as comma-separated strings or DataFrame columns and performs correlation analysis. This test determines the strength and direction of the linear relationship between two continuous variables. Pearson correlation measures linear relationships, Spearman correlation measures monotonic relationships (rank-based), and Kendall's tau is robust to outliers and suitable for small samples. The test calculates a correlation coefficient ranging from -1 (perfect negative correlation) to +1 (perfect positive correlation), with 0 indicating no linear relationship. A significant result (p-value < alpha) indicates that the observed correlation is statistically different from zero. Effect size interpretation: |r| < 0.1 = negligible, 0.1-0.3 = small, 0.3-0.5 = medium, >0.5 = large (custom thresholds may be used). EXAMPLE USE CASES: examining relationship between height and weight, analyzing correlation between study time and test scores, investigating association between variables in research.
